feature_contract.goal: Preserve original native HUD, result GOAL, and projected rank SpriteNode identity when direct put_sprite_ex or put_sprite_ex2 is reentered by distinct exact producers so a native ScreenHud draw cannot erase the child physical source.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only native put_sprite_ex and put_sprite_ex2 source-capture/post-call queue tagging; preserve all existing D3DX batch ordering, R84 shader veto, SkyGlow, lens, game input/FFB, DXVK freeze and R26_SAFE.
trace_stages: Original put_sprite_ex/ex2 source enters with its return RVA, exact parent semantics and an atomic SpriteNode semantic entry serial.
Nested native producers may register a different exact GOAL/rank SpriteNode while the outer original call continues on the same live priority queue.
Bounded stable-root reachability selects newly appended children, and preserved identity continues through R84 physical left and right D3D9 GPU Draw or native fail-closed fallback.
subcomponents: Capture semantic registration source entry generation alongside the original exact HUD source token and queue/external scope on both native hook entry paths.
Retain newer other-exact nested source tags through the existing semantic registry's serial guard while tagging unknown, same and stale native SpriteNodes normally.
Apply compile-time negative regressions for GOAL/rank, unknown/same, stale serial and no entry proof, preserving D3D9/R84 queue/fallback isolation.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original native put_sprite_ex/ex2 SpriteNode queue and R84 left/right physical draw
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Direct original parent tags unknown and matching HUD children without overriding any distinct nested exact source tag.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Nested exact GOAL and rank, stale recycled pointers, same/unknown source and queue fallback
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Newer GOAL and projected rank tags survive, older/stale/unknown/same owners are eligible, and stable-root queue proof remains active.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Win32 R84 x86 source, host x64, rollback/package, Domain, HUD Inspector and Full Source gate
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All mandatory GitHub Actions succeed at one exact validation-bearing SHA; Quest3 runtime remains untested.

diagnosis.original_evidence: The original native put_sprite_ex/ex2 may enqueue multiple children and reenter exact HUD, GOAL, or vehicle rank producers before returning; original callsite and bounded tails are already known.
source_trace: The native hook captures original semantic scope and priority-list tails before calling the original producer.
The nested original producer may register its own exact source and token before the outer native source returns.
The common post-call direct tagger previously registered scope/token without the semantic registry's preserveNewerExactSince entry serial.
That registration could clobber newer nested source identity before the existing R84 queue picks the physical draw owner.
diagnosis.root_cause: The direct post-call tagger did not pass the exact original entry registration serial into RegisterSpriteNodeScope, so it could erase another distinct newer exact producer published by a nested native call.
alternatives_rejected: Do not globally change unknown sprites to HUD, force a D3DX Flush, bypass root/tail reachability, inherit stale world WVP or alter the right-eye renderer.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Capture the SpriteNode semantic next serial with the original entry Snapshot and give it to the shared mutex-held exact nested producer guard when registering direct native siblings.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Native constexpr tests exercise newer GOAL and rank against outer +TIME/unknown, None and same-source, stale/reused generation and zero entry serial.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: R84 will still use its existing selected SpriteNode queue identity for left/right or original fallback. Exact HMD stereoscopic output is not proven without matching runtime evidence.

notes: Class A structural native HUD producer-collision repair; baseline 2be4f0729f3d82fb548cb012ce96a3fd44ca5d89; compile-time regression in changed header; no Quest3 test. Material commit SHA will be recorded after the actual SHA exists.
